workItem: Extend the existing /api/roadmap read-only runtime projection so capital-ai.online/roadmap can consume complete latest-CURRENT_MAIN project-roadmap state even when Production intentionally lags under the 5-merge deployment cadence.
projectStage: PVC-02 Controlled Implementation / PVC-08 Production Operations
priorityReason: The current public /roadmap bundles task state at deploy time, but AGENTS requires the live/current-state dashboard to follow latest CURRENT_MAIN while cadence intentionally permits Production lag.
scopeBoundary: Reuse the existing /api/roadmap runtime and GitHub current-main read path; no second Roadmap API, registry, lifecycle, deployment controller or task authority.
Read-only GitHub repository access only. No Issues, Pull Requests, branches, provider settings or secrets are mutated by the runtime endpoint.
Canonical task truth remains docs/architecture/ROADMAP.md for migrated projects and docs/projects/<project>/ROADMAP.md for other current project owners.
Historical/terminal/superseded sections are excluded fail-closed; ambiguous current-state rows surface as projection warnings rather than synthetic PASS.
FE consumption remains a separate owner-correct successor after this OPS endpoint is Human/CODEOWNER-merged.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/roadmap/state resolves one exact GitHub CURRENT_MAIN SHA and reads every canonical project Roadmap against that exact SHA.
SEC/QM migrated state is consumed from docs/architecture/ROADMAP.md without reviving compatibility pointers as independent task sources.
Current heading/table identities including CLIENT, GOV, OPS, FINTECH, COMP, SEO, SOCIAL, SEC and QM are projected with owner/folder/label/state/dependency metadata.
Historical, DONE_MAIN, TERMINAL, SUPERSEDED, NOT_APPLICABLE and retired status is excluded from active/ready/held projection.
Current-state markers that cannot be mapped to a canonical identity fail closed into explicit projection warnings.
The cadence endpoint reads private-repository current-main files through the same authenticated GitHub Contents path instead of unauthenticated raw.githubusercontent.com assumptions.
Focused unit tests pass, followed by ordinary exact-head Governance/build/test/Security checks.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment; no agent self-merge.
